description: `__get__(instance, owner)`, `__set__(instance, value)` and `__delete__(instance)` on an object stored in a class.
Defines `__set__` or `__delete__` and takes priority over the instance `__dict__`.
Defines only `__get__`; an instance attribute with the same name shadows it. Functions and `cached_property` work this way.
Hook called when the class is created, giving a descriptor its owner class and attribute name (PEP 487).
Keeping values in `instance.__dict__` (or a weak dictionary keyed by the instance) because one descriptor serves every instance.
